new_packages.label: גְּבוּרָה וְלֵב
new_packages.reason: This package is 'new' in the strong sense — Torah 249 has no entries at all in torahData.js, so every package here is a first-time proposal. The source text contains 3 explicit bechina equalities connecting gevurah, the heart, conquering the yetzer hara, and Samson's feats into one conceptual domain. These form an independent domain of inner strength/courage that is not reducible to any other Torah's packages.

proposed_edges.proof: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת (אבות פ"ד): אֵיזֶהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ
וְזֶה בְּחִינַת גְּבוּרוֹת שִׁמְשׁוֹן... דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁבָּא לוֹ חֹזֶק וְתֹקֶף גְּבוּרָה בַּלֵּב

observations:
Torah 249 is one of the shortest Torahs in Likutay Moharan Volume 1 — just two sentences. It is a pure, concentrated teaching with a single argument and no branching subthemes.

The entire Torah is built around one concept: גְּבוּרָה (inner strength/courage). The Rebbe makes three bechina equalities:
1. Gevurah = the heart ('עִקַּר הַגְּבוּרָה בְּהַלֵּב') — the definitional equation establishing that true strength is not physical but cardiac/inner.
2. Gevurah = conquering one's yetzer hara ('אֵיזֶהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ') — the Mishnaic definition equating all heroic battle to the inner spiritual battle.
3. Gevurah = Samson's feats ('גְּבוּרוֹת שִׁמְשׁוֹן') — the biblical exemplar who received this heart-strength from the spirit of God.

These three equalities form one star-shaped connected component with גבורה at the center (degree 3) and the other three nodes each connected only to it (degree 1).

The verdict is NEW_PACKAGES_PROPOSED because Torah 249 is completely absent from torahData.js — the entire Torah needs to be encoded from scratch, with 1 package and 3 bechina edges.

No evil mirror package is warranted. The yetzer hara appears as the object being overcome (the conquered enemy), not as a developed conceptual domain. The Torah is purely positive — a brief teaching on the nature and source of inner courage. There are no evil-polarity bechina chains to form a counter-package.

One potential eitza connection (not a bechina) exists: רוּחַ ה' → גְּבוּרָה. The spirit of God produces/clothes in gevurah — this is directional cause-effect, not parallel nature. It should be encoded as an eitza edge, not included in Package 1.
